about: T-Edition's dressing-room costumes (dressroom.html, 3.0.7 / EX 2.0.6) by tools/ted_costumes.py: graphics only; unlocks from events/achievements; falcon_song_no = the music player number when the guide's song title matches its display name.

costumes.name: Silk Dress: Hybrid
costumes.jp: シルクのドレス : ハーフ
costumes.unlock: This costume is obtained in a treasure box in Maduin's House in the Eidolon World during the World of Ruin. It's a dress her mother, Madeline, made.

costumes.jp: ボーダム治安連隊軍服：ルシ

costumes.model: The appearance used here is Lightning's model from Final Fantasy XIII.
